summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust filed an 8-K reporting the sale of Embassy Suites Dulles Airport, a 150-room hotel in Herndon, Virginia, to Woodland Park Road LLC. The sale closed August 24, 2026, for approximately $22.8 million in cash, netting about $22.3 million after selling expenses. The company used ~$20.6 million of proceeds to pay down a mortgage secured by 13 hotels. Pro forma financials were included. Watch for further deleveraging or asset sales as the company continues portfolio optimization.
